dogecoin.text: #Bitcoin has a supply limit. No coins can ever be added above 21 million. Unlike Bitcoin, #Dogecoin has no supply limit. Each minute, 10,000 Doge is added into the network. At this rate, miners add more than 5 billion coins per year.
#Dogecoin will probably cease to exist: https://t.co/U7H5kmdq3s

#Dogecoin has a huge supply. 129 billion coins. 10,000 coins are mined per minute. That's 14 million new coins added to the supply every day, which adds up to about 1 billion coins added every eighty days.
#Dogecoin currently has a higher market cap than every DeFi token.
How dare people invest in #bitcoin, #gamestop, and #dogecoin when a bank is nice enough to give them a 0.000000000000002% return on their savings.
